name: app
label: App (Android / iOS / Flutter)
context: Companion phone app that pairs with a study watch over BLE, decodes protobuf measurement payloads, stores health data of identifiable clinical trial participants locally, and uploads it to a backend.
threat_model: Attacker within BLE radio range for a few minutes
Attacker who obtains the participant's phone, possibly unlocked or rooted
A spoofed watch feeding false data into a participant record
Accidental exposure of participant identity through logs, crash reports or analytics
surfaces: BLE pairing, bonding and key storage
protobuf decode and payload validation from the device
health data at rest, backup flags and platform file protection
participant identity in logs, crash reports and analytics
backend transfer, certificate validation and authorisation
